The airship features a long, cigar-shaped envelope with 'U.S. NAVY' text visible on the side. It has a gondola suspended beneath the forward section and distinct tail fins. A bright light source from a tower on the right illuminates the scene, casting strong beams and shadows.

The light beams emanating from the tower have a soft, 'painted' quality rather than sharp volumetric definition, and the tower structure itself lacks clear geometric detail, appearing somewhat melted into the background.
